derivation: After C3-P3-ADM-011, reserve-a is DISPUTED and blocks its reserved partition, and reserve-b's contribution is in that partition. A new RESERVE repeats the request with the current history. Owner rulings R-f and R-g (EXCLUSIVE-KEY-HISTORY section 6): a WITHHELD with EXCLUSIVE_HISTORY_UNAVAILABLE or EXCLUSIVE_KEY_OCCUPIED carries that reason alone and empty budgets, an exclusive withholding takes precedence over numerical history reasons, and a current complete history supplied with it is still committed with the retraction marking. The only reason is EXCLUSIVE_KEY_OCCUPIED, not EXPOSURE_DISPUTED as well, and budgets are empty, so no blocked aggregate judgment is reported.
